# Step 1: Identify Sydney photos directory and image file list, then create a .tar archive

fs_pw=[p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='file_system'][0]['password']
fs_token=apis.file_system.login(username='kri-powe@gmail.com', password=fs_pw)['access_token']

# Find candidate directories containing 'sydney'
found_dirs = apis.file_system.show_directory(
    access_token=fs_token,
    directory_path='/',
    substring='sydney',
    entry_type='directories',
    recursive=True
)
print('candidate_sydney_dirs_count', len(found_dirs))
print('candidate_sydney_dirs', found_dirs[:20])

# Prefer the directory under /home/kristin/photographs/...
candidates=[d for d in found_dirs if 'photographs' in d and 'sydney' in d.lower()]
print('photographs_sydney_dirs_count', len(candidates))

# Choose the shallowest (shortest path) that looks like the actual photos directory
sydney_dir = sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: (len(x.split('/')), len(x)))[0] if candidates else None
print('chosen_sydney_dir', sydney_dir)

# List all files under it (non-recursive isn't enough; use recursive)
all_entries = apis.file_system.show_directory(
    access_token=fs_token,
    directory_path=sydney_dir,
    entry_type='files',
    recursive=True
)
print('files_in_dir_count', len(all_entries))

# Filter likely photo files by extension
photo_exts = {'.jpg','.jpeg','.png','.gif','.bmp','.tiff','.webp'}
photo_files=[p for p in all_entries if any(p.lower().endswith(ext) for ext in photo_exts)]
print('photo_files_count', len(photo_files))
print('sample_photo_files', photo_files[:10])

# Prepare tar file path
parent_dir = '/'.join(sydney_dir.rstrip('/').split('/')[:-1])
tar_path = f"{parent_dir}/sydney_photographs.tar"
print('tar_path', tar_path)

# Check if tar exists
exists = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=fs_token, file_path=tar_path)
print('tar_exists_before', exists)

# Create tar (compress_directory will create tar if compressed_file_path ends with .tar)
if exists:
    # overwrite if exists
    overwrite=True
else:
    overwrite=False

compress_res = apis.file_system.compress_directory(
    directory_path=sydney_dir,
    access_token=fs_token,
    compressed_file_path=tar_path,
    delete_directory=False,
    overwrite=overwrite
)
print('compress_result', compress_res)
